SCAN Costco Medicare Advantage (HMO)

Carrier: SCAN Health Plan. Plan type: HMO. Period: 2027 to 2027.

16 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 22 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and 67 Part D benefits (benefits with a coverage stage, which the SBC profile has no place for) are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document SCAN_COSTCO_MEDICARE_ADVANTAGE_HMO_H5425_140_000 (schema version 1.2.0).

extension.valueString: CMS Plan Benefit Package (PBP) Benefits, contract year 2027, release "PBP Benefits-2027" (https://www.cms.gov/files/zip/pbp-benefits-2027.zip), downloaded 2026-10-06. Files read: pbp_Section_A.txt, pbp_Section_C.txt, pbp_Section_C_OON.txt, pbp_Section_C_POS.txt, pbp_Section_D.txt, pbp_b10_amb_trans.txt, pbp_b13_other_services.txt, pbp_b14_preventive.txt, pbp_b16_dental.txt, pbp_b17_eye_exams_wear.txt, pbp_b18_hearing_exams_aids.txt, pbp_b1a_inpat_hosp.txt, pbp_b1b_inpat_hosp.txt, pbp_b2_snf.txt, pbp_b4_emerg_urgent.txt, pbp_b6_home_health.txt, pbp_b7_health_prof.txt, pbp_b8_clin_diag_ther.txt, pbp_b9_outpat_hosp.txt, pbp_mrx.txt, pbp_mrx_tier.txt, pbp_mrx_p.txt, PlanArea.txt, PlanRegionArea.txt. PBP key: pbp_a_hnumber "H5425", pbp_a_plan_identifier "140", segment_id "0" (written padded to 3 digits in plan_identifiers).
Plan type: pbp_a_plan_type "01" (HMO), written as plan_type "HMO".

Section A values with no Benefit Plan Standard field, verbatim: bid_id "H5425_140_0"; version "10"; orgtype "01"; pbp_a_org_name "SCAN HEALTH PLAN"; pbp_a_org_type "01"; pbp_a_ben_cov "1"; pbp_a_plan_geog_name "San Francisco County"; pbp_a_eghp_yn "2"; pbp_a_special_need_flag "2"; pbp_a_contract_partd_flag "1"; pbp_a_continue_yn "2"; pbp_a_formulary_web_addr "www.scanhealthplan.com"; pbp_a_pharmacy_website "www.scanhealthplan.com".

Contacts and the provider directory from Section A: pbp_a_curmbr_phone "(800)559-3500" (Customer Service Contact Phone Number for Current Medicare Beneficiaries), written as contacts.member_services_phone; pbp_a_org_website "www.scanhealthplan.com", not written as contacts.website: it has no scheme, so it is not a URI, and the importer does not add one; pbp_a_phys_web_addr "www.scanhealthplan.com", not written as network_tiers[tier_id=IN].provider_directory_url: it has no scheme, so it is not a URI, and the importer does not add one. Section A gives 1 provider directory address per plan, so it belongs to the in-network tier only.

Service area from PlanArea.txt, 1 county in CA. county_code is the SSA state and county code, not FIPS, so service_area.counties[].fips is null. Each county as county_code, county, stcd, and the partial_flag and eghp_flag values on its rows: 05480 San Francisco CA partial_flag "" eghp_flag "0".

Premium from Section D: pbp_d_mplusc_premium "2.00" (Plan Premium Amount (A/B)), written as premium.amount in USD; the file states no period, so premium.period is not written; pbp_d_mco_pay_reduct_yn "2" (the plan does not use its MA rebates to reduce the Part B premium), so part_b_premium_reduction is not written.
In-network deductible: the plan says it has none (pbp_d_inn_deduct_yn "2", pbp_d_inn_deduct_partb_yn "", pbp_d_inn_deduct_amt ""); no slot is written.
In-network out-of-pocket maximum type, no Benefit Plan Standard field (schema gap, spec section 9.1): pbp_d_out_pocket_amt_type "1" (Lower).

Every non-blank Section D deductible and out-of-pocket cell, verbatim, in file order: pbp_d_inn_deduct_yn "2"; pbp_d_out_pocket_amt_yn "1"; pbp_d_out_pocket_amt_type "1"; pbp_d_out_pocket_amt "2500.00"; pbp_d_inn_max_enr_oopc_bens "01"; pbp_d_inn_max_enr_m_yn "1"; pbp_d_inn_max_enr_m_cat_ex "1a;1b;2;3-1;3-2;3-3;3-4;4a;4b;5a;5b;6;7a;7b;7c;7d;7e1;7e2;7f;7g;7h1;7h2;7i;7j;7k;8a1;8a2;8b1;8b2;8b3;9a1;9a2;9b;9c1;9c2;9d;10a1;10a2;11a;11b1;11b2;11c1;11c2;11c3;12;14a;14d;14e1;14e2;14e4;14e5;15-1-I;15-2;15-3;16a;17a;17b;18a;".
Benefits: the 41 service categories in fhir/pbp-crosswalk.json (the workgroup MVP), 38 written. Other PBP service categories are not imported yet (docs/specs/pbp-importer.md section 8).

Part D: pbp_mrx.txt mrx_drug_ben_yn "1" (Yes), mrx_benefit_type "4" (Enhanced Alternative), mrx_formulary_tiers_num "5", mrx_form_model_type "5F", mrx_form_model_desc "Preferred Generic, Generic, Preferred Brand, Non-Preferred Drug, Specialty Tier". Written: pharmacy and 67 Part D benefits (docs/specs/pbp-part-d-mapping.md).

Part D deductible: mrx_alt_ded_charge "2" (No, enter amount), mrx_alt_ded_amount "450.00", mrx_alt_ded_type_yn "2", mrx_alt_no_ded_tier "0110000" (Tier 1; Tier 2), mrx_alt_ded_tier_cstshr_yn "1". Written as pharmacy.deductible 450 USD with applies_to_tiers T3, T4, T5, and a DEDUCTIBLE coverage stage. The plan charges its own amount; the amount is not the contract year 2027 standard deductible, 700 USD (CMS, "Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Medicare Advantage (MA) Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies", April 6, 2026, Attachment V, Table V-2 (page 95) and Table V-6 (page 99), https://www.cms.gov/files/document/2027-announcement.pdf).

pharmacy.out_of_pocket_max and the CATASTROPHIC stage's applies_after_total_out_of_pocket are 2400 USD, the contract year 2027 Part D annual out-of-pocket threshold. No PBP column states it; source: CMS, "Announcement of Calendar Year (CY) 2027 Medicare Advantage (MA) Capitation Rates and Part C and Part D Payment Policies", April 6, 2026, Attachment V, Table V-2 (page 95) and Table V-6 (page 99), https://www.cms.gov/files/document/2027-announcement.pdf. Each CATASTROPHIC benefit's cost share is $0, the cost sharing for a covered Part D drug after the threshold, also not read from a PBP cell: 42 CFR 423.104(d)(5)(i) (eCFR, version of 2026-10-01): "After an enrollee's incurred costs exceed the annual out-of-pocket threshold ... for 2024 and each subsequent year, cost-sharing equal to $0"; 42 CFR 423.104(e)(2) holds alternative prescription drug coverage to "cost-sharing no greater than" that once the threshold is met, and 42 CFR 423.104(f) holds enhanced alternative coverage to paragraph (e) (docs/specs/pbp-part-d-mapping.md section 6.6).

Pharmacy networks: mrx_partd_network_loc "101101" (Long-Term Care; Standard/Preferred Retail; Out-of-Network; Standard/Preferred Mail-Order), the locations the tier rows use; written as pharmacy_networks RETAIL_STANDARD, RETAIL_PREFERRED, MAIL_ORDER_STANDARD, MAIL_ORDER_PREFERRED, OUT_OF_NETWORK, LONG_TERM_CARE. Out-of-network cost-sharing structure: mrx_alt_oon_cstshr_struct "2" (Standard Retail Copay/Coinsurance plus a differential between the OON billed charge and the Standard Retail allowable). default_day_supply is not written: the file states days per tier, location and supply, and each benefit carries its day_supply (docs/specs/pbp-part-d-mapping.md section 5.2).

Coverage stages: mrx_alt_pre_icl_cost_share "3" (Cost Share Tiers), mrx_alt_cstshr_post_oopt "1" (No cost sharing). Written as DEDUCTIBLE, INITIAL, CATASTROPHIC (CATASTROPHIC after 2400 USD); no coverage gap stage: Table V-6 of the CY 2027 Rate Announcement (page 99) lists a Deductible Phase, an Initial Coverage Phase and the Out-of-Pocket Threshold, and nothing between them. Part D benefits are written for INITIAL (pbp_mrx_tier.txt) and CATASTROPHIC (pbp_mrx_p.txt); what the deductible does is carried by applies_to_deductible and deductible_ref on the INITIAL steps.
